messages:
alex_pm: FYI sales flagged ACME (enterprise) requesting a Terraform provider + official Python SDK snippet + SSO/SCIM setup for Dedicated. Need triage and timeline.

nina_sales: They want provisioning flow + example infra-as-code + SCIM role mapping doc. Pilot ask: 6 weeks.

sam_se: To scope: 1) Terraform provider for instance creation/capacity routing, 2) Python quickstart (auth + streaming examples), 3) SCIM mapping guide for okta, 4) marketplace listing. Which are must-haves vs nice-to-have?

alex_pm: Must-haves = Terraform provider + Python quickstart + SCIM guide. Marketplace can wait. Pilot acceptance: install + `terraform apply` -> instance + successful tokenized inference call + SCIM sync creates user.

jordan_eng: We have an internal prototype of the TF provider. Need to generalize schema, add acceptance tests and CI. Example config snippet we expect to support:

```
resource "redwood_dedicated" "acme" {
  name   = "acme-prod"
  tier   = "dedicated"
  region = "us-west2"
  capacity_profile = "high-throughput"
}
```

jordan_eng: Provider will surface creds and endpoint via outputs; need to coordinate with solutions for wiring auth.

lee_support: Support asks for a short runbook for common fails (expired tokens, role mapping inconsistencies). Also need examples for VPC/private control plane flows.

maria_solutions: I'll draft the SCIM mapping doc and test cases. Nina — can you confirm whether ACME will use SAML or OIDC as IdP?

nina_sales: ACME uses Okta SAML + SCIM for provisioning. They want attribute mapping for email, displayName, and groups->roles.

kate_security: Heads up: SCIM provisioning + token lifecycle for Dedicated requires KMS/HSM notes + audit logging checklist. Security review needed before pilot sign-off.

jordan_eng: Rough timeline if we allocate one ENG + solutions: 2w to harden TF provider + tests, 1w for Python samples + CI, 1w for SCIM guide + security review = 4w + buffer. Feasible if deprioritize marketplace now.

alex_pm: Proposed owners: @jordan_eng (eng lead), @maria_solutions (docs/solutions), @lee_support (support runbooks), @kate_security (security review). Backlog tags: integration/terraform, integration/sdk-python, security/scim. Priority: P1 for pilot.

sam_se: Can we list concrete acceptance tests? e.g. 1) `terraform apply` creates instance and outputs endpoint, 2) python quickstart performs `client.generate(...)` and streams up to 30s, 3) Okta SCIM provisioning creates user with specified role mapping, 4) audit logs show provisioning event.

alex_pm: I'll create the intake GH issue with checklist + attach ACME ask doc. Also will schedule a 1hr grooming tomorrow to finalize scope. PMM — can you prep a short onboarding 1-pager to ship after pilot? :eyes:

pmm: Yep — will prepare onboarding + quickstart sheet.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for branch `feature/terraform-provider` to staging.

alex_pm: Next steps: I will file issues, add owners, and tag backlog. If anyone has objections to scope or acceptance criteria, flag now. :thumbsup:
